I am renting this small piece of land here in Machinga, and maize is my family's food, so I must try my best. If I get the FISP coupon this year, I will use the NPK and urea on the maize, but I cannot afford to buy fertilizer at full price. I keep a few chickens and goats, so I will carry what little manure I have to the plot. I will plant the seed I saved from last year because hybrid seed is expensive when the coupon does not come, and I have no money for pesticides or irrigation — I depend on the rains.
